description: This file is a shell script serving as a framework for interoperability testing. It sources configuration files and other scripts, defines functions to build specific git versions, generates wrapper scripts, and manages environment setup for testing different git versions.

methods.name: build_version
methods.description: Builds a specific version of git specified by a test identifier, managing build directories, repository archives, and configuration copying.

methods.name: wrap_git
methods.description: Generates a shell script that emulates a git executable by setting environment variables and executing git.

methods.name: generate_wrappers
methods.description: Creates wrapper scripts for git commands, setting up the environment for version testing.
